west-africa.title: Ọdịda Anyanwụ Afrịka
west-africa.description: Naịjirịa, Ghana, Côte d'Ivoire, Senegal, Mali, Burkina Faso, Guinea, Benin, Togo, Sierra Leone, Liberia na Niger — Lagos, Accra, Abidjan, Dakar, Abuja, Bamako, Ouagadougou na ụsọ oké osimiri Gulf of Guinea.
